LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_Jian.label: jian
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_Jian.description:
The straight double-edged sword, called the gentleman of weapons.
Requires 5 Tianxia knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_Silk.label: silk weaving
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_Silk.description:
Raise silkworms on mulberry leaves and weave their thread into the softest cloth in the world.
Requires 5 Tianxia knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_JadeFloor.label: jade courtyards
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_JadeFloor.description:
Pave courtyards with polished green stone set in patterns of clouds.
Requires 5 Tianxia knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_Hanfu.label: hanfu
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_Hanfu.description:
Sew the flowing robes with crossed collars and wide sleeves worn by scholars and officials.
Requires 5 Tianxia knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_Dumplings.label: dumplings
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_Dumplings.description:
Fold minced meat and greens into thin dough and steam them in bamboo baskets.
Requires 5 Tianxia knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_PaperLantern.label: paper lanterns
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_PaperLantern.description:
Stretch oiled paper over bamboo frames and hang red lanterns along every path.
Requires 5 Tianxia knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_TeaCulture.label: tea culture
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_TeaCulture.description:
A cup of tea before sleep, a cup on waking. The body rests better when the mind is calm.
Tradition: Colonists rest 5% faster.
Requires 15 Tianxia knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_Granary.label: ever-normal granary
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_Granary.description:
Buy grain when it is cheap and store it against bad years: the harvest is worked with care.
Tradition: Colonists harvest 6% more from plants.
Requires 15 Tianxia knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_SilkRoad.label: silk road
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_SilkRoad.description:
From oasis to oasis the caravans of Tianxia carry silk west and silver east, and they know every price.
Tradition: Colonists get 6% better trade prices.
Requires 20 Tianxia knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_Guandao.label: imperial armoury
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_Guandao.description:
Forge the heavy guandao glaive and lamellar armour for the imperial guard.
Requires 10 Tianxia knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_Repeater.label: repeating crossbow
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_Repeater.description:
A crossbow with a magazine of bolts on top: pull the lever, loose, pull again.
Requires 15 Tianxia knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_PorcelainKiln.label: porcelain kiln
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_PorcelainKiln.description:
Fire white clay hotter than any potter in the world and paint it in cobalt blue.
Requires 15 Tianxia knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_FireLance.label: fire lance
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_FireLance.description:
A tube of black powder tied to a spear. When it is lit, it spits fire and shrapnel at the enemy.
Requires 30 Tianxia knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_Physicians.label: imperial physicians
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_Physicians.description:
Needles, herbs and pulse-reading: the court physicians know a cure for nearly everything.
Tradition: Colonists tend wounds with +10% quality and gain immunity 8% faster.
Requires 25 Tianxia knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_Examination.label: imperial examination
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_Examination.description:
Anyone may sit the examination, and anyone who passes may rule. So everyone studies.
Tradition: Colonists learn 10% faster.
Requires 35 Tianxia knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_FireArrows.label: fire arrows
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_FireArrows.description:
Archers drill until the volley lands as one. The enemy line burns before it reaches the wall.
Tradition: Colonists gain +2 shooting accuracy.
Requires 35 Tianxia knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_Porcelain.label: porcelain mastery
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_Porcelain.description:
The kilns of Jingdezhen fire a thousand pieces to keep one. Every craftsman learns that patience.
Tradition: Crafted items have a 6% chance to come out one quality level higher.
Requires 40 Tianxia knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_Harmony.label: harmonious realm
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_Harmony.description:
Heaven's seal is where it belongs, and every household works in calm order.
Tradition: Colonists work 3% faster and their mental break threshold drops by 3%.
Requires 50 Tianxia knowledge unless this is your heritage.
Unlocked by finishing the nation's story.
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_FireArrowBattery.label: fire-arrow battery
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_FireArrowBattery.description:
A wheeled box of tubes, each holding a rocket arrow. Light one fuse and the whole nest of bees leaves at once.
Requires 40 Tianxia knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_PowderArms.label: Tianxia powder arms
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_PowderArms.description:
The Tianxia way of making a matchlock or a flintlock: the barrel, the lock, the stock and the drill to use them.
Outside your heritage, this can be researched only once Tianxia has reached the Age of Powder.
Requires 30 Tianxia knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_SteamArmy.label: Tianxia steam army
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_SteamArmy.description:
Cartridges, rifled barrels and a uniform: the army Tianxia raised when the factories came.
Outside your heritage, this can be researched only once Tianxia has reached the Age of Steam.
Requires 45 Tianxia knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_ElectricArmy.label: Tianxia electric army
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_ElectricArmy.description:
Machine-made arms, a steel helmet and a field uniform in drab: the army Tianxia raised when the wires came.
Outside your heritage, this can be researched only once Tianxia has reached the Electric Age.
Requires 60 Tianxia knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_Works.label: Tianxia works
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_Works.description:
The first electric works of Tianxia: one machine the nation is proud of, built to its own taste.
Outside your heritage, this can be researched only once Tianxia has reached the Electric Age.
Requires 50 Tianxia knowledge unless this is your heritage.
